  <li><strong>Student politics:</strong> The ABVP has swept the Delhi University Students&#x27; Union (DUSU) polls, triggering a fresh political confrontation between the BJP and Congress.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary conduct:</strong> Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla has reiterated that the exercise of freedom of speech within the House remains strictly subject to established parliamentary rules.</li>
  <li><strong>International trade:</strong> The New Zealand Parliament has passed the India Free Trade Agreement (FTA) Bill, bringing the bilateral pact closer to full implementation.</li>
</ul>
